title: Page 10
content_zh:
他边听边流下伤心懊恼的眼泪，他对不起赵霖的母亲，也对不起自己的儿子，更对不起岳父临死前的托付。

吴佩茹知道自己反被设计时，一直武装的她顿时兵败如山倒，而就在这时候，赵耀山推门进入侦讯室，从他脸上不可遏抑的愤怒看来，他已经知晓了一切。

吴佩茹只能哭着求赵耀山跟赵霖饶恕她，至少看在她替赵家生了两个孩子的分上，原谅她这一次。

尽管是受害者，但赵霖没有对吴佩茹采取任何报复行为，关于颜芳菲的死，她该受的法律制裁是由法官决定，至于对赵家的伤害，一切还是交给父亲来处理。

回到家一看到白薇秀，赵霖马上像个孩子般窝进她怀中，低低的恳求，“抱着我，不要放开……”

“我永远都不会放开你，我会永远陪在你身旁。”白薇秀像个母亲，给予他最强大的爱与温暖。

曾经，他受过的伤害，在此，她用爱将之弭平消除。

曾经，她只是他的假妻，算计着其中最大的效益，但真爱改变了一切。

白薇秀轻柔的卸下两人身上的衣物，用最温柔亲昵的方式，告诉他，她会给予他全部的自己，他永远不会失去她。

我爱你。她用身体语言诉说着爱意。

我也爱你。他热切的回应。

这一场假妻算计，最终，两个人都是赢家。

时光的飞逝总在不经意间，人们总是喜欢把生活过得很倔强，除非经历重大的变故，才会痛定思痛。

在赵霖跟白薇秀结婚两周年纪念日这一天，赵霖为爱妻再次举办一场温馨幸福的婚礼，这时她的肚子里已经怀有两人爱的结晶，也就是赵家的第三代，而且根据妇产科医生的诊断，还是一对双胞胎男宝宝，这个好消息传回赵家，让公公赵耀山的精神为之一振。

两年的时间不算久，但足够发生许多事情。

赵耀山跟吴佩茹离婚，对于她面临的法律制裁，他没有伸出任何援手，不过他仍旧像以往那般疼爱着赵谚跟赵瑜，对他来说，他们依旧是赵家的子孙。

吴佩茹以过失杀人被起诉，判刑多年，她入狱期间，赵瑜跟赵谚多次去探望，这是赵耀山能做到的最大宽容。

当年丑陋的真相被揭发之后，赵耀山大病一场，得知赵霖十岁时被绑架所受的折磨，他深觉对不起已经过世的原配跟岳父大人，很多想法也有所改变了。

他从赵氏集团退了下来，准备好好休养身体，将来还等着过群孙环绕的快乐老年生活，且他也不逼赵霖接手集团，这孩子这些年走来也够辛苦了，就顺着他的心意给他自由，赵耀山接受儿子的建议找来专业的经营团队接管赵氏食品，推荐此经营团队的还是赵霖，他们父子俩的关系也因此慢慢修复。

赵耀山提前立好了遗嘱，将赵霖外公跟生母留下来的股分全给了赵霖，至于他自己的部分则打算分成三等分。

不过就在几个月后，他的大媳妇白薇秀生了，两个白白胖胖又可爱的孙子，让赵耀山高兴极了，于是他联络律师，先是包了一亿元的大红包给劳苦功高的媳妇，也更改了遗嘱，让两个孙子一出生就成了名符其实的“金孙”。

两个儿子满月那天，白薇秀看到大红包笑到嘴巴都闿不拢，赵霖苦笑要她节制一点。

“老婆，你不是跟我说过真爱无价吗？怎么你现在眼中只有爸包给你的红包，没有我？”

“亲爱的老公，你干么跟钱争风吃醋啊。”她赶紧将红包藏到身后，笑得尴尬。

“好吧，那我问你，你比较爱钱还是我？”

“……当然是你。”

“你犹豫了，亲爱的。”呜呜。

“没有，你误会了，我哪有犹豫。”白薇秀赶紧掩饰，抱抱跟亲亲已经受伤的老公。“老公，我爱你，好爱好爱你喔……”亡羊补牢，希望不会太晚啊！

——全书完

番外——吴德亮

结婚两年后，赵霖决定给心爱的妻子一场真正且符合她梦想中的完全婚礼，但白薇秀却拒绝了，主要原因在于她现在肚子里正怀着小宝宝，而且一场婚礼下来，坦白说，当新娘的还真是XX的累啊，比当婚顾师还要累，更何况两年前那场婚礼多少已经有完成她的梦想，当时她花他的钱可没手软。

“在别人眼中我们已经是夫妻了，再办一场婚礼该怎么解释？”她腻在老公的怀里，边说边打了个呵欠，怀孕的她很容易感到疲倦。

“很简单啊，就说是二度婚礼，因为我们太相爱了！好啦，老婆，这一次我们办一场小巧温馨的婚礼就好，只邀请亲朋好友参加，如果你觉得累，就交给安安处理。”

白薇秀一直有个遗憾，两年前的婚礼未能将捧花交给许安安，所以她想了想，同意了。“好，那我们就把洪伟的PUB包下来，举行婚礼，好吗？”

“这有什么问题，只要你喜欢，我都会尽力完成。”

于是白薇秀跟赵霖有了第二场婚礼，地点就在洪伟的PUB，邀请的都是亲朋好友，赵霖的弟弟、妹妹赵谚跟赵瑜也来了，这一次白薇秀挑了件粉红色的蓬蓬裙小礼服，头上戴着花圈，简单却幸福，而她唯一的伴娘就是许安安，她最好的朋友，伴郎当然是他的男友洪伟。

婚礼非常浪漫，所有来参加的人都是他们爱情的见证者，洪伟情商了知名的驻唱歌手现场演唱情歌，舞池里欢迎各位爱侣相拥共舞，大家几乎都是结伴而来，唯有吴德亮是自己一个人前来。

好友上一回的婚礼他因为有重大案件没办法参加，这一回说什么也要来。

他一个人坐在舞池旁默默喝着酒，满不起眼的，看着赵霖拥着娇妻卿卿我我，说真的，有给他羡慕到，然后他眯起眼眸，回想起往事。

接着他又继续喝酒，喝得很尽兴，离开前他去找了白薇秀，赵霖刚好不在她身边，时机很好。

“恭喜。”吴德亮是真心道贺。

“谢谢。”白薇秀笑得很甜蜜，但认真一瞅，这才发现对方正是曾经把她吓得半死的刑警局大队长。为什么他也会来参加他们的婚礼？

“我是赵霖的高中同学兼死党。”他自我介绍。

“喔喔。”赵霖怎么从来没跟她提过？

“其实我也算是你们的媒人。”吴德亮突地说道。

白薇秀困惑的看着他，等待他的说明。

“当初赵霖找我商量，约你到刑事警察局谈一谈，藉此恐吓你，如此一来你答应他的机率就会高许多。”话点到为止，相信她听得懂。

什么？！白薇秀瞪大眼。她当初可是吓个半死，她还感激赵霖替她解决了麻烦。

“所以说本来就不关我的事，不用约谈我？”她咬牙切齿的问。

“没错。”吴德亮答得飞快。很好，饵放了，对方也吃了，可以闪人了。

她眯起眼，不满的望向朝她走来的赵霖，暗自下定决心，今晚可有得他瞧了！

新婚夜却被踢到客厅睡沙发，赵霖深感欲哭无泪。

本来欢喜抱着老婆进到房间，准备履行夫妻应尽的义务，白薇秀怀孕初期他忍得很辛苦，好不容易孕期稳定他们可以欢爱了，却被她给轰出来。

原因是，他被好友吴德亮出、卖、了！

赵霖再也忍不住怒火，拨打吴德亮的手机，对方一接起，他劈头就开炮，“你这家伙！干么陷害我！”
content_en:
While listening, he shed tears of sadness and annoyance. He was sorry for Zhao Lin's mother, his own son, and even more sorry for what his father-in-law had entrusted him to before his death.

When Wu Peiru knew that she had been set up, she, who had always been armed, was suddenly defeated. At this moment, Zhao Yaoshan pushed the door open and entered the interrogation room. Judging from the uncontrollable anger on his face, he already knew everything.

Wu Peiru could only cry and beg Zhao Yaoshan and Zhao Lin to forgive her, at least for the sake of giving birth to two children for the Zhao family, forgive her this time.

Although she was a victim, Zhao Lin did not take any revenge against Wu Peiru. Regarding Yan Fangfei's death, the legal sanctions she should receive were decided by the judge. As for the harm to the Zhao family, everything was left to her father to handle.

As soon as he saw Bai Weixiu when he got home, Zhao Lin immediately nestled into her arms like a child and begged in a low voice, "Hold me, don't let go..."

"I will never let you go, I will always be by your side." Bai Weixiu was like a mother, giving him the most powerful love and warmth.

The hurt he had suffered in the past was eliminated by her love.

Once, she was just his fake wife, calculating the maximum benefit, but true love changed everything.

Bai Weixiu gently removed the clothes from the two of them, and told him in the most gentle and intimate way that she would give him all of herself and that he would never lose her.

I love you.She expresses love with her body language.

I love you too.He responded eagerly.

In the end, both of them are winners in this fake wife plot.

Time always flies by inadvertently, and people always like to live a very stubborn life. Only when they experience major changes will they learn from the pain.

On the second wedding anniversary of Zhao Lin and Bai Weixiu, Zhao Lin once again held a warm and happy wedding for his beloved wife. At this time, she was already pregnant with the child of their love, the third generation of the Zhao family, and according to the diagnosis of the obstetrician and gynecologist, they were twin boys. This good news was sent back to the Zhao family, which lifted the spirits of father-in-law Zhao Yaoshan.

Two years is not a long time, but it is enough time for many things to happen.

Zhao Yaoshan divorced Wu Peiru, and he did not lend any helping hand to the legal sanctions she faced. However, he still loved Zhao Yan and Zhao Yu as much as before. To him, they were still descendants of the Zhao family.

Wu Peiru was prosecuted for manslaughter and sentenced to many years in prison. During her imprisonment, Zhao Yu and Zhao Yan visited her many times. This was the greatest tolerance that Zhao Yaoshan could do.

After the ugly truth was revealed, Zhao Yaoshan fell seriously ill. After learning about the torture Zhao Lin suffered when he was kidnapped when he was ten years old, he felt deeply sorry for his deceased first wife and father-in-law, and many of his thoughts changed.

He retired from the Zhao Group and was ready to recuperate and live a happy old life surrounded by grandchildren in the future. Moreover, he did not force Zhao Lin to take over the group. The child had worked hard over the years, so he was freed according to his wishes. Zhao Yaoshan accepted his son's suggestion and hired a professional management team to take over Zhao Foods. It was Zhao Lin who recommended this management team, and the relationship between the father and son gradually repaired.

Zhao Yaoshan made a will in advance and gave all the shares left by Zhao Lin's grandfather and biological mother to Zhao Lin. As for his own part, he planned to divide it into three equal parts.

However, just a few months later, his eldest daughter-in-law Bai Weixiu gave birth to two chubby and cute grandchildren. Zhao Yaoshan was very happy, so he contacted his lawyer and first gave a big red envelope of 100 million yuan to his hard-working wife. He also changed his will so that the two grandsons would become true "golden grandchildren" as soon as they were born.

On the day when her two sons were one month old, Bai Weixiu laughed so hard when she saw the big red envelope that she couldn't hold her lips together. Zhao Lin smiled bitterly and asked her to be more restrained.

"Honey, didn't you tell me that true love is priceless? Why do you only see the red envelope from daddy now, not me?"

"Dear husband, why are you so jealous of Qian?" She quickly hid the red envelope behind her back and smiled awkwardly.

"Okay, let me ask you, do you love money or me more?"

"...Of course it's you."

"You hesitated, dear." Woo woo.

"No, you misunderstood, how could I hesitate." Bai Weixiu quickly covered up, hugging and kissing her injured husband."Husband, I love you, I love you so much..." I hope it's not too late!

——Complete book

Extra - Wu Deliang

After two years of marriage, Zhao Lin decided to give his beloved wife a real wedding that was in line with her dreams, but Bai Weixiu refused. The main reason was that she was currently pregnant with a baby, and after a wedding, frankly speaking, being a bride was really tiring, even more tiring than being a wedding consultant. What's more, the wedding two years ago had more or less fulfilled her dream, and she was not lenient in spending his money at that time.

"In the eyes of others, we are already husband and wife. How should we explain another wedding?" She yawned while talking in her husband's arms. Being pregnant, she felt tired easily.

"It's very simple, let's call it a second wedding, because we love each other so much! Okay, wife, this time we will have a small and warm wedding. Only relatives and friends will be invited to attend. If you feel tired, leave it to An An."

Bai Weixiu has always had a regret. She was unable to give the bouquet to Xu Anan at the wedding two years ago, so she thought about it and agreed."Okay, then let's take over Hong Wei's PUB and hold the wedding, okay?"

"What's the problem? As long as you like it, I will try my best to complete it."

So Bai Weixiu and Zhao Lin had their second wedding. The venue was Hong Wei's PUB. They invited all their relatives and friends. Zhao Lin's brother and sister Zhao Yan and Zhao Yu also came. This time Bai Weixiu chose a pink tutu dress with a wreath on her head. It was simple but happy. Her only bridesmaid was Xu An'an. Her best friend and best man was of course her boyfriend Hong Wei.

The wedding was very romantic, and everyone who attended was a witness to their love. Hong Wei arranged for a well-known resident singer to sing the love song live. All lovers were welcome to embrace and dance on the dance floor. Almost everyone came together, but Wu Deliang came alone.

He was unable to attend his friend's last wedding because of a major case, but he was determined to come this time.

He sat alone by the dance floor and drank quietly, looking very inconspicuous. He watched Zhao Lin hugging his beloved wife and making love to each other. To be honest, he was envious. Then he narrowed his eyes and recalled the past.

Then he continued to drink, drinking very happily. Before leaving, he went to find Bai Weixiu. Zhao Lin happened to be away from her, which was a good time.

"Congratulations." Wu Deliang congratulated sincerely.

"Thank you." Bai Weixiu smiled sweetly, but when she took a closer look, she realized that the other person was the captain of the Criminal Police Bureau who had scared her half to death.Why did he come to their wedding?

"I am Zhao Lin's high school classmate and best friend." He introduced himself.

"Oh." How come Zhao Lin never mentioned it to her?

"Actually, I can be considered your matchmaker." Wu Deliang said suddenly.

Bai Weixiu looked at him confused, waiting for his explanation.

"Zhao Lin came to me to discuss the matter and asked you to come to the Criminal Police Station to have a talk to intimidate you. In this way, the chance of you agreeing to him would be much higher." I believe she understands the words so far.

What?!Bai Weixiu's eyes widened.She was scared to death at first, and she was grateful to Zhao Lin for solving the trouble for her.

"So it's none of my business in the first place, so there's no need to interview me?" she asked through gritted teeth.

"That's right." Wu Deliang answered quickly.Very good, the bait is put out and the opponent eats it, so you can dodge.

She narrowed her eyes and looked dissatisfied at Zhao Lin, who was walking towards her, and secretly made up her mind that he would be the one to watch tonight!

On the wedding night, he was kicked to the living room to sleep on the sofa. Zhao Lin felt like crying without tears.

Originally, Xixi entered the room with his wife in his arms, ready to fulfill their obligations as husband and wife. Bai Weixiu endured it very hard in the early stages of her pregnancy. Finally, the pregnancy was stable and they could have sex, but she kicked her out.

The reason is that he was betrayed by his friend Wu Deliang!

Zhao Lin could no longer hold back his anger and called Wu Deliang's cell phone. As soon as the other party picked up the phone, he fired at him, "You guy! Why did you frame me!"
